description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named PendingSelfReviewSummary within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates logic related to managing search filters and retrieving counts for pending self-review actions for a specific employee in the dashboard's action summary module. The class uses traits and other entities to set review statuses and provides methods to get group identifiers, descriptions, and count pending reviews.

classes.name: PendingSelfReviewSummary
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates logic for summarizing pending self-reviews for an employee within the OrangeHRM dashboard module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters for a given employee, setting relevant review statuses for actionable and self-review states.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns a fixed group ID representing the category 'Pending Self Reviews'.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the string label 'Pending Self Reviews' identifying this group of actions.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Returns the count of pending self-review actions for the employee, retrieved via the service layer.
